mentions.name: Newspeak PostgreSQL TCP protocol implementation
mentions.description: Implements the PostgreSQL TCP wire protocol in Newspeak so a Chrome web browser can talk to a GnuCash database and parse Postgres result sets from simple queries. Built on the author's Newspeak TCP library and still at a bare-minimum, possibly broken stage.
mentions.source_excerpt: Writing a Newspeak implementation of the PostgreSQL TCP protocol!. Talking to a GnuCash database from Chrome web browser. Uses my Newspeak TCP library. Both are bare minimum, probably very broken, but I am able to parse a Postgres result set from a simple query.

evidence.value: Writing a Newspeak implementation of the PostgreSQL TCP protocol!. Talking to a GnuCash database from Chrome web browser. Uses my Newspeak TCP library. Both are bare minimum, probably very broken, but I am able to parse a Postgres result set from a simple query.
